metadata.title: When your ONE kill looks like pure accidental genius in VALORANT
metadata.description:
That kill that wasn’t supposed to happen but did anyway.
Watch me pretend it was all skill, not luck.
Only VALORANT can make this look like a pro move.

Hit follow if you love accidental clutches!

Click if you’ve ever won by sheer accident!
